question: Compare Bellhaven Textile Museum visitor-register retention and Kestwick Lens Workshop calibration-log retention, including both exceptions.
answer:
[1] Bellhaven Textile Museum visitor registers are retained for 18 months, unless an unresolved access complaint requires longer retention.

[2] Kestwick Lens Workshop calibration logs are retained for 12 months, unless an unresolved calibration dispute requires longer retention.
